non_mutating_review_steps: Confirm the notice window remains open through 2026-10-01 for the stated renewal.
Confirm the users and entitlements with the application owner.
Confirm contractual reduction rights and notice deadline.
Approve the renewal change outside this tool.
Verify realized savings against later invoices.

disclosures: All data in this report is illustrative; no customer systems or live accounts are connected.
Technology Spend contains Cloud, direct AI, and SaaS canonical scopes only.
FinOps Watchdog and Recovery Economics are diagnostic-only and add no spend.
This report is analysis, not verified savings or automated remediation.
Cloud Cost Guard is not connected, and Lumen is not grounded in this report.

reconciliation.assertion: Canonical Cloud, direct-AI, and SaaS scopes sum exactly to Technology Spend.
